verdict.rationale: Docs include curl examples and a get-started guide with parameters (docs-1,3,4,7,21), but there is no evidence of an interactive, runnable API reference (e.g., Swagger/OpenAPI console) — probes for openapi.json/swagger.json and a markdown docs export all returned 404 (probe-2, probe-3), indicating only static documentation rather than a true interactive reference.
